items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: this man had a picture of the head of John the Baptist.

ctx.x: Well then, it seemed like everybody (inaudible) and deGaulle says, well, you'll have to go within the year. So the _______ now, they're going to leave because, you know, the Belgians didn't know what everybody was going to do. And what happened was he says now -- this man was a big millionaire.
He says, on your day off come over to Belgium and see what's happening. I went over there and this man had a picture of the head of John the Baptist. (Inaudible)
